Automatic watering system

Leaving Cert CS

A micro:bit system that reads soil moisture and runs a small water pump through a relay. Full write-up below.

micro:bitSensorsRelayOLED

Leaving Cert Computer Science project

An automatic plant watering system built around a micro:bit.

What it does

The system measures how wet the soil is, shows the reading on an OLED display, and switches a small water pump through a relay module. A battery pack powers the micro:bit so it can run away from a computer.

Parts used

  • BBC micro:bit
  • Soil moisture sensor
  • OLED display
  • Relay module
  • Small water pump and tubing
  • Battery pack
